review_candidates.title: Network Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Network Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the company’s network infrastructure to support secure and reliable brokerage operations. Daily responsibilities include configuring, monitoring, and managing switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless networks, as well as handling user connectivity issues and ensuring high network availability. The Network Administrator will collaborate with IT and operations teams
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Network Administrator is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the company’s network infrastructure to support secure and reliable brokerage operations.
Ability to work on-site in Cairo, manage priorities in a fast-paced financial services environment, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications 4+ years of network administration experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Technical Support to diagnose and resolve network connectivity and performance issues.
